2. Daily Summary

On this date, the YSD crew focused on the installation of DensGlass exterior sheathing and the continued installation of metal framing on both the interior and exterior of the building. Framing crews performed layout, measuring, and cutting of metal studs at the designated cutting station, with framers verifying measurements prior to cutting and spacing each frame to its correct length during installation. All elevated framing work was carried out from aerial and boom lifts, with operators properly tied off at all times, and boom lifts were also used to transport framing material to elevated work areas. Proper personal protective equipment was worn by all workers throughout the day. Support activities included the transport of tools and equipment to active work areas — with a fire extinguisher accompanying the cutting equipment — and ongoing housekeeping throughout the site, with the trash buggy in use for the collection and removal of scrap metal and debris.

3. Safety Measures Verified
  • PPE Compliance — Hard hats, high-visibility clothing, gloves, and eye protection worn by all workers at all times.
  • Fall Protection / Work at Heights — All elevated framing work performed from aerial and boom lifts, with operators properly tied off (100% tie-off) at all times.
  • Aerial Lift Operations — Lifts operated safely for elevated installation work and for transporting framing material to work areas.
  • Cutting Station Controls — Designated cutting station established with chop saw; fire extinguisher staged at the station and carried alongside cutting equipment during transport.
  • Housekeeping — Continuous housekeeping performed throughout the site; trash buggy in use for the collection and removal of scrap metal.
  • Material Handling — Metal framing, tools, and equipment transported safely to assigned work areas.
